rule.statement: The doctrine of exceptio rei venditae et traditiae cannot be applied when a vendor sells a share that may be allotted to them in a partition case, but they are not parties to the case.
rule.supporting_quote: The above doctrine cannot be applied to the transfer in deed No.933 (P2) because Sirisena and Welliya have, by the said deed, transferred the share that may be allotted to them by partition case No.7445/P. But they are not parties to the said case. Therefore no share could or would be allotted to them in the said partition case. In fact in the Final Decree of the said partition case, no share has been allotted to them.
